aFreshWalletMustStartWithoutANon: A fresh wallet must start without a non-admin payout timestamp.
aRecoveryContactCanAlreadyWithdrawFromTh: A recovery contact can already withdraw from this wallet now: the proof of life has lapsed. If that is not intended, renew it or set its unlock time in the future before continuing.
aWalletCanHaveAtMostMaxBeneficiaries: A wallet can have at most {MAX_BENEFICIARIES} recovery contacts. This keeps every wallet action affordable on-chain; remove one to make room.
aWalletCanHaveAtMostMaxStreaming: A wallet can have at most {MAX_STREAMING_PAYMENTS} streaming payments. This keeps every wallet action affordable on-chain.
aWalletCanHaveAtMostMaxUsers: A wallet can have at most {MAX_USERS} owners. This keeps every wallet action affordable on-chain; remove an owner to make room.
addAtLeastOneOwnerOrAddA: Add at least one owner, or add a recovery path that can still use the wallet.
freshStreamingPaymentValue1MustStartBefo: Fresh streaming payment {value1} must start before it ends.
freshStreamingPaymentValue1MustStartWith: Fresh streaming payment {value1} must start with zero already-paid amount.
multisigKeyWalletAppearsInPoweredOwnerRe: Multisig key {wallet} appears in powered owner records {value2}. One signature contributes their combined power {value3}; the threshold does not require distinct people.
recoveryContactsNeedAProofOfLifeBefore: Recovery contacts need a proof of life before they can be used.
stateBeneficiariesIndexAndStateBeneficia: state.beneficiaries[{index}] and state.beneficiaries[{otherIndex}] must not share beneficiary wallets.
stateIntendedStakeCredentialMustBeNoneOr: state.intended_stake_credential must be None or Some with a 28-byte Cardano credential hash.
stateProofOfLifeUnlockTimeAndState: state.proof_of_life_unlock_time and state.proof_of_life_increment must both be set or both be None.
theProofOfLifeIsOnButNo: The proof of life is on, but no recovery contact is named. Nobody can claim this wallet if it runs out, so right now it protects nothing. Add a recovery contact to make it work.
thisWalletHasNoOwnerAndNoMultisig: This wallet has no owner and no multisig path, and its only recovery (a recovery contact) cannot unlock until far in the future. Funds will be inaccessible until then. Set a sooner unlock time or add another recovery path.
walletNameMustFitInMaxWalletName: Wallet name must fit in {MAX_WALLET_NAME_BYTES} bytes.
walletNameTooLong: Wallet name must fit within {limit} bytes.
